submit_report.name: submit_report
submit_report.description: Submit a structured report of a hazard or welfare check. Call as soon as you know what and where; don't wait for perfect answers.

hazard.description: What is happening: fire, smoke, gas, flood, power, medical, collapse, welfare_check, other, plus a few words.

location_text.description: Address, cross streets or landmark, as confirmed with the caller.

people_at_risk.description: Number of people at risk, 0 if none or unknown.

injured_or_trapped.description: True if anyone is injured or trapped.

vulnerability.description: Vulnerability flags, e.g. wheelchair, oxygen, dialysis, elderly_alone, baby, no_car, pets, deaf, blind.

language.description: Caller's language code, e.g. en, es.

drill_code.description: Drill code if the caller gave one, else empty.

flag_urgent.name: flag_urgent
flag_urgent.description: Flag this call as life-safety urgent (P0) or self-harm. Call IMMEDIATELY when you hear a P0 phrase, before anything else.

reason.description: Short reason, e.g. trapped, not_breathing, chest_pain, overdose, weapon, self_harm, fire_cannot_exit.

keyword.description: The caller's exact words that triggered this.

route_to_human.name: route_to_human
route_to_human.description: Find the best available person on our team for this caller. Returns oncall_number (may be empty), responder_name, brief and match_reason.

needs.description: Skills needed, e.g. medical, mental_health, evac_logistics, safety_escort, housing, facilities, listener, general.

language.description: Caller's language code, e.g. en, es.

severity.description: Severity: P0 life in danger now, P1 active hazard, P2 needs a person soon, P3 routine.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the caller's situation for the person taking over.

route_to_human.execution_message_description: Let me find someone for you.

schedule_callback.name: schedule_callback
schedule_callback.description: Queue a callback from a person when no one is available now or the caller prefers a call back.

reason.description: Why they need a callback, e.g. no_responder_available, silent_caller, distress, request_followup.

preferred_time.description: When they prefer, in their words, or empty for as soon as possible.

lookup_info.name: lookup_info
lookup_info.description: Look up approved, current information: shelters, evacuation orders, road closures, resources, hotlines, campus info. Never guess instead of calling this.

question.description: The caller's question, in their words.

zone_id.description: Zone id if known, else empty.

create_request.name: create_request
create_request.description: Create a help request (escort, errand, maintenance, ride, check on someone, supplies). Read back and get a yes first.

type.description: Request type, e.g. escort, errand, maintenance, ride, check_on_person, supplies, other.

details.description: What they need, in a sentence.

set_reminder.name: set_reminder
set_reminder.description: Set a reminder call for the caller. Read back and get a yes first.

when.description: When, in the caller's words, e.g. tomorrow 9 AM.

enroll_checkin.name: enroll_checkin
enroll_checkin.description: Enroll a person in wellness check-in calls. Status stays pending_consent until that person agrees on the first call.

person_name.description: Name of the person to call.

language.description: Caller's language code, e.g. en, es.

needs.description: Needs, e.g. mobility, oxygen, medication, lives_alone.

enrolled_by.description: self, or the caller's name and relationship.

notify_contact.name: notify_contact
notify_contact.description: Send a message to the caller's contact. Only after the caller explicitly gave permission.

consent.description: Must be true: the caller explicitly agreed.

check_status.name: check_status
check_status.description: Check the status of a request by its code. Requires the last 4 digits of the caller's phone.

phone_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the phone used for the request.

opt_out.name: opt_out
opt_out.description: Opt the caller out. Use when they say stop calling, don't call me, or delete my data.

scope.description: calls = no more calls; analytics = don't use my call in stats; all = both + delete my data.

register_volunteer.name: register_volunteer
register_volunteer.description: Register a caller as a volunteer. They stay pending until a coordinator verifies them.

skills.description: Skills, e.g. medical, driver, translation, general.

transfer_to_human.name: transfer_to_human
transfer_to_human.description: Warm-transfer the caller to the person found by route_to_human. Only call after route_to_human returned a non-empty oncall_number.

private_handoff_option.message: DIZA line transfer. Caller {{caller_name}}, language {{language}}. {{brief}}. You got this because {{match_reason}}.

transfer_to_human.execution_message_description: Connecting you now. Please stay on the line.

transfer_to_crisis_line.name: transfer_to_crisis_line
transfer_to_crisis_line.description: Transfer to the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. Use for self-harm or suicidal callers who agree to be connected. Never use transfer_to_human for them.
transfer_to_crisis_line.execution_message_description: I'm connecting you now. Please stay on the line.

swap_to_crisis.name: swap_to_crisis
swap_to_crisis.description: Hand the call to the crisis intake agent when the caller reports a hazard or emergency happening now (smoke, fire, gas, flooding, lines down, someone missing).

swap_to_inbound.name: swap_to_inbound
swap_to_inbound.description: Hand the call back to the everyday line when it turned out not to be an emergency. Never use if any P0 sign was mentioned.

end_call.name: end_call
end_call.description: End the call after the caller has a clear next step and has said goodbye.
